declarations.docstring: A finite-dimensional indecomposable at a sink is vertex-simple or has a surjective incoming map.
A finite-dimensional indecomposable at a source with finitely many outgoing arrows is vertex-simple or has an injective outgoing map.
Indecomposability: the representation is nonzero, and any two arrow-stable families of vertex submodules giving a direct-sum decomposition have one family identically zero.
The vertex-simple dimension vector: dimension one at the selected vertex and zero elsewhere.
